observations: Two stacked white plastic IBC (Industrial Bulk Container) tanks.
The tanks are secured with metal wire frames.
The top tank has a blue spigot and a white plastic filler cap.
The bottom tank has a white plastic filler cap.
The tanks show significant surface stains and discoloration, particularly on the sides and top.
The tanks are resting on a wooden pallet.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI JACIN' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The photo shows white plastic, which is not iron-reinforced; the metal frame is visible but its material is not clearly iron.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 show white plastic tanks.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

claims.claim: It can be used for fish pond, water storage, diesel...
claims.evidence: This is a functional claim that cannot be verified from photos.

risks.risk: The tanks may be leaking or have structural damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the tanks being filled with water and the water level remaining stable.
A photo of the technical specification label on the side of the tank.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest standard IBC size

risks.risk: The metal frame may be rusted or compromised.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the metal frame joints and the base.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the side of the top tank to confirm capacity.
Video of the tanks being filled with water to check for leaks.
Close-up photos of the metal frame and the base of the tanks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used IBC tank. While the condition and capacity are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional, leaking unit.
